Market today:
The mood is cautiously optimistic for tech. Fed Governor Waller's signal to hold rates steady is the real driver, easing pressure on growth stocks and your leveraged positions. AI momentum from Nvidia and Google also provides a tailwind for your chip and tech heavy book.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a major concern, down -58.21% and leveraged. SPAL, also leveraged and new, is down -39.48%. Both need immediate attention given margin amplifies drops. QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are all flagged for trimming, indicating broader weakness in your core tech/chip ETFs.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on any further Fed commentary for shifts in rate expectations. Also, monitor the broader chip sector's reaction to the Nvidia/AI news.

Bottom line:
Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and respecting your stops, while cautiously observing positive macro signals.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its -58.21% loss and leveraged decay. Respect your stop at 200, or adjust it tighter.
SPAL: Review SPAL's -39.48% loss and leveraged nature. Its default stop at 21.38 is far; consider a tighter risk management plan.
CRWD: Scanner shows a BUY setup (entry 202.74-202.54, stop 201.45). Consider adding to your profitable position if you want more exposure.
